proof_body:
by
  intro M _ s
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨w⟩ := h.preconnected 1 x
    have key : ∀ (a b : M) (w : (SimpleGraph.mulCayley s).Walk a b), a⁻¹ * b ∈ Subgroup.closure s := by
      intro a b w
      induction w with
      | nil => simp
      | @cons a c b hadj _ ih =>
        have h1 : a⁻¹ * c ∈ Subgroup.closure s := by
          rcases ((SimpleGraph.mulCayley_adj _ _ _).mp hadj).2 with h | h
          · exact Subgroup.subset_closure h
          · have := (Subgroup.closure s).inv_mem (Subgroup.subset_closure h)
            simpa using this
        have := (Subgroup.closure s).mul_mem h1 ih
        simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    simpa using key 1 x w
  · intro h
    have key : ∀ x : M, x ∈ Subgroup.closure s → ∀ y, (SimpleGraph.mulCayley s).Reachable y (y * x) := by
      intro x hx
      induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem g hg =>
        intro y
        by_cases he : y = y * g
        · rw [← he]
        · exact SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ((SimpleGraph.mulCayley_adj _ _ _).mpr ⟨he, Or.inl (by simpa using hg)⟩)
      | one => intro y; simp
      | mul a b _ _ ha hb => intro y; rw [← mul_assoc]; exact (ha y).trans (hb _)
      | inv a _ ha =>
        intro y
        have := ha (y * a⁻¹)
        simpa using this.symm
    haveI : Nonempty M := ⟨1⟩
    refine ⟨fun u v => ?_⟩
    have := key (u⁻¹ * v) (by rw [h]; trivial) u
    simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (M : Type*) [Group M] (s : Set M), (SimpleGraph.mulCayley s).Connected ↔ Subgroup.closure s = ⊤
